{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Eoaq reforms''' were instigated by [[Eoaq the Expansive|Eoaq]] the Expansive. They simplified the bureaucracy of the [[Atrisian Empire]]; the reforms included the simplification of the [[Atrisian script]]. However after his death, the [[Six Savage Viziers]] proceeded with counter-reforms that reverted most of those reforms.
